newsitem.title: JAPAN: Hyundai Petrochem strike plan yet to affect Tokyo.
newsitem.headline: Hyundai Petrochem strike plan yet to affect Tokyo.

text.p: News that a South Korean petrochemical firm is planning a partial strike has yet to affect the Tokyo naphtha market, traders said on Tuesday.
"Naphtha traders are not talking about it, and prices have not been fluctuating because of it," one trader said.

Another trader who had just talked on the phone with South Korean naphtha dealers said end-users in South Korea were in the middle of procuring February delivery cargoes and they were not cutting down their requirements.
"They are seeking cargoes just as usual," he said. "It was like they believe the strike would not impact their production."
Naphtha is used as feedstock at petrochemical factories.
The unionised workers of Hyundai Petrochemical Co plan to go on partial strike on Wednesday afternoon in protest at a new labour law, a union official said.
He said although plants would continue to run, the strike was expected to have an impact on production. He was unable to give an estimate of expected losses in production.
